title.value: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains
title.justification: The title clearly summarizes the focus of the paper, which is on addressing the load planning and sequencing problem specifically for double-stack trains in intermodal rail terminals.
title.quote: The load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains

extractions.description: This paper investigates the integrated load planning and sequencing problem for double-stack trains in intermodal railway terminals. It introduces two integer linear programming formulations to improve load planning by reducing the number of container handlings compared to traditional methods and demonstrates its effectiveness through a case study with real data from the Canadian National Railway Company.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper does not focus on climate change directly but addresses operational efficiency in double-stack train loading, which may have indirect implications for emissions reduction.
climate_change_is_central.quote: This paper addresses the integrated load planning and sequencing problem (LPSP) for double-stack trains.

secondary_categories.quote: A case study based on real data provided by the Canadian National Railway Company highlights that the LPSP can reduce the number of container handlings in intermodal terminals.

applications.value: Optimization of freight routing and scheduling
applications.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing the loading sequence and planning in intermodal railway terminals, which is a form of optimizing freight routing and scheduling.
applications.quote: This decision-making problem occurs in intermodal terminals and consists in assigning containers from a storage area to slots on railcars of outbound trains and in determining the loading sequence of the handling equipment.
